The formula below gives the blood alcohol concentration for a male.

$$BAC_{\text{Male}} = \dfrac{10N - 7.5H}{6.8M}$$

Where;

$N$ is the number of standard drinks consumed,

$H$ is the number of hours of drinking,

$M$ is the person's weight in kilograms.

Charlie weighs 80 kg and consumes 6 standard drinks in 3 hours. What is his $BAC$, correct to 1 significant figure?

solutions.latex:
Substitute $N = 6$, $H = 3$ and $M = 80$ into the formula.
$$\begin{aligned} BAC &= \dfrac{10 \times 6 - 7.5 \times 3}{6.8 \times 80} \\ &= 0.0689\ldots \\ &\approx 0.07 \end{aligned}$$
This matches option D.
